Principal coordinates analysis (PCoA) of genomes on three feature matrices: codon frequencies, amino-acid frequencies and gene-structure statistics. PCoA uses one genome per genus (best BUSCO, then N50, then lowest id), taken from genomes with complete codon, amino-acid and gene-structure data. Genera with no such genome are left out; the counts are in the table below.

PERMANOVA uses 999 permutations, by phylum and by order. When a grouping has too few genera or groups, the table says it was not tested. Axes with negative eigenvalues are reported in the permanova tables; read the variance shown on the axes with that in mind.

## Genera used

```{python}
flat_table("ordination_summary", "ordination")
```

## Codon frequencies

```{python}
single("O01_codon_pcoa_phylum", "PCoA of codon frequencies, coloured by phylum.", "ordination", "75%")
single("O02_codon_pcoa_class", "PCoA of codon frequencies, coloured by class.", "ordination", "75%")
flat_table("codon_permanova", "ordination", columns=["grouping", "metric", "n_genera", "n_groups", "pseudo_F", "R2", "p_value", "n_permutations_run", "caveat"])
```
